newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Demand in EDP sale 642 million shares.
newsitem.headline: Demand in EDP sale 642 million shares.

text.p: Demand in the forthcoming privatisation of Portuguese state electricity company EDP-Electricidade de Portugal was about 642 million shares in the first three days of pre-registration, a banking source said.
This level of demand represents 3.5 times the number of shares likely to be on offer.
"At the end of yesterday, applications had been received for 642 million shares," the source told Reuters.
The government is expected to sell off some 30 percent of EDP, or 180 million shares, but could float up to 49 percent if there is very strong demand.
The pre-registration period runs from May 19 until June 6.
The privatisation of a 30 percent stake could raise some 400 billion escudos in revenues.
The sale will take place at a special session on Lisbon bourse on June 16.
